content.short: Swaap Maker V2 is non-custodial RFQ market-making infrastructure with defensive liquidity safeguards.
content.description: Swaap Maker V2 is non-custodial market-making infrastructure for DeFi liquidity providers. The protocol combines on-chain vaults, off-chain quotation logic, and settlement safeguards such as circuit breakers, last look, and max drawdown controls. Its liquidity pools automatically compound fees and are represented as ERC-20 tokens for easier composability and auditing. Swaap's strategies are based on quantitative market-making models designed to optimize LP returns against holding assets. On Mantle, Swaap Maker V2 gives users and protocols access to more controlled, professional-style liquidity provisioning.
content.meta: Swaap Maker V2 provides RFQ market-making infrastructure and safeguarded liquidity pools on Mantle.
